default/32510.htm.text: Inspector Adler: Ta da! Don't look so surprised! I used a secret method known to the Pathfinders of Kamaloka to fly here

Q00128_PailakaSongOfIceAndFire/32510-00..text: Inspector Adler: It is time for you to use the Scroll of Escape I gave you.

Q00128_PailakaSongOfIceAndFire/32510-01..text: Inspector Adler: The Spirite's power is flowing smoothly. You have certainly justfield my trust in you! Thanks to you, we are rapidy restoring stability. Of course, that means the dimensional portal that connects your world to ours is also quickly closing. Hurry and take my hand! That sword belongs…

Q00128_PailakaSongOfIceAndFire/32510-02..text: Inspector Adler: Please accept this Scroll of Escape. Its power will allow you to safely return to your world.
